scope: Q02-death ran only on qa-cursor using forced_failure_mode=anthropic_agent_execution. The template selects /bin/false in place of the worker CLI, yielding a deterministic nonzero exit after claim; this does not test an operator-issued kill, SIGKILL, or orphaned-worker behavior. Claude remained normal. By 22:33:44Z baseline config was restored byte-for-byte, both pools were healthy, and no QA template workspaces were visible. Tester subsequently confirmed Cursor displayed the expected retryable worker error.

events.summary: User chose a deterministic exit fixture for the next QA test instead of a manual worker kill. QA Relay source, template version, coderd version and baseline pool health were checked; no QA template workspaces were visible.

Original mode-0600 QA config backed up byte-for-byte. Only qa-cursor forced_failure_mode changed to anthropic_agent_execution, selecting /bin/false; Claude remained none, global reapDelay stayed 0s and dispatch deadline stayed 10m.
Original QA-only Relay stopped gracefully; both loopback listeners were free before restart with the scoped fixture.
QA Relay verified qa-cursor with the deterministic worker-exit fixture configured.

Readiness and status listener HTTP 200, both QA pool-health gauges one, no QA template workspace visible, no claim or fail counters for the restarted Relay, and binary checksum still matches the prior baseline.
